record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: For quartic threefolds, does the birational categorical Torelli theorem hold, i.e. does equivalence of the relevant Kuznetsov components imply birationality of the threefolds?

evidence.quote: Does the birational Categorical Torelli theorem hold

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{P}^4$ be a smooth quartic threefold over $\mathbb{C}$. Its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves $D^b(X)$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) = \langle \mathcal{K}u(X), \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1), \mathcal{O}_X(2), \mathcal{O}_X(3) \rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is the right orthogonal to $\langle \mathcal{O}_X, \mathcal{O}_X(1), \mathcal{O}_X(2), \mathcal{O}_X(3) \rangle$. The component $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is a 2-Calabi–Yau category and serves as a categorical analogue of the period of $X$.

Prove or disprove: for any two smooth quartic threefolds $X$ and $X'$, if there exists a $\mathbb{C}$-linear exact equivalence $\mathcal{K}u(X) \simeq \mathcal{K}u(X')$, then $X$ and $X'$ are birational.
artifact.category_tag: Categorical Torelli theorems for Fano threefolds
artifact.status_search_result: Search results indicate the birational categorical Torelli problem for smooth quartic threefolds remains open. Related results have been established for nearby cases (quartic double solids, Gushel–Mukai threefolds, del Pezzo threefolds of degree 4), and Kuznetsov's Fano threefold conjecture has been resolved, but no source found confirms the birational categorical Torelli statement for smooth quartic threefolds in $\mathbb{P}^4$.

status_evidence.snippet: Lists the birational Categorical Torelli problem for quartic threefolds among open questions.
status_evidence.claim: The birational categorical Torelli theorem for quartic threefolds is posed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Higher-dimensional moduli spaces on Kuznetsov components of Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work covers cubic threefolds, index 1 degree 14 Fanos, and double Veronese cones, extending previous results for quartic double solids and Gushel–Mukai threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances have covered related Fano threefolds but not smooth quartic threefolds.

status_evidence.title: New perspectives on categorical Torelli theorems for del Pezzo threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Treats categorical Torelli for del Pezzo threefolds of degree 4 and related cases.
status_evidence.claim: Categorical Torelli results progressing for adjacent classes, but quartic threefold case not addressed.
